slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers review's table row for DR Congo says rural registry offices, which it counts as 877 of 979 local offices, record births in entirely paper carbon-copy registers of four copies per event, with no computer or mobile technology used in registration; it dates this to 2019 reports and cites the UNECA CRVS snapshot.

The same row states that no computers or mobile technology are used in the registration process at local offices and that it found no evidence of digital recording in rural offices as of 2019 reports.

The row mentions recent pilots, naming Masina (urban), and plans to digitise historical registers, against 979 local offices of which it counts 877 as rural; it gives no date for the pilot, so the 2019 date of the reports it cites is used.
